events.region: Boyd, NE; Holt, NE; Keya Paha, NE; Rock, NE
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRLBF

The National Weather Service in North Platte has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Rock County in north central Nebraska...
Northwestern Holt County in north central Nebraska...
Eastern Keya Paha County in north central Nebraska...
Southwestern Boyd County in north central Nebraska...

* Until 900 AM CDT.

* At 754 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 12 miles east of
Springview, moving southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles.

* Locations impacted include...
Bassett, Stuart, Newport, Thomas Creek State Wildlife Management
Area, Mariaville, and Pony Lake.

This includes the following highways...
Highway 183 between mile markers 181 and 204.
Highway 20 between mile markers 259 and 282.
Highway 12 between mile markers 67 and 71.

events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...

Wabash River near Linn Grove affecting Adams and Wells Counties.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Indiana...

Wabash River near Bluffton IN affecting Wells County.

For the Wabash River...including Linn Grove, Bluffton IN, Wabash,
Logansport...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River near Linn Grove.

* WHEN...Until early Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The flooding of county roads begin.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 AM EDT Wednesday the stage was 12.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
just after midnight tonight and continue falling to 6.8 feet
Sunday evening.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Muscatine; Scott; Rock Island
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
Areas of fog, dense in some locations will persist through 830 AM.
The dense fog will be especially common in and near river valleys
and other low lying areas, and reduce visibilities under one
quarter mile.

If traveling this morning, be prepared for fog that could bring
sudden and significant reductions in visibility over short
distances. If you encounter dense fog, slow down, give yourself
plenty of braking distance between other vehicles, and be sure to
keep headlights on low beam. Be especially cautious in school zones.
Conditions should after 830 to 9 AM.

* WHERE...Chuuk Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...Through at least Thursday, or longer if conditions warrant.

* IMPACTS...Very strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

over the next few days.
